# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P20](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0020), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c8 P23](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0023), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, freckled, expressionless face. He is known for his broad, grinning countenance.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P24](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0024), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, quiet, and suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts. Despite his bashfulness, he is good-natured and a very hard worker. He is known to be quite stolid and easily contented.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

- To marry and settle down on his farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P23](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0023)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school. As a young man, he admired Anne Shirley and drove her, along with Jane and Diana, to a concert at the White Sands Hotel, though he decamped before the supper due to his shyness. When his father gave him the upper farm, he wished to marry Anne, but was too bashful to propose himself. He persuaded his sister Jane to propose to Anne on his behalf. After Anne rejected the proposal, Billy did not break his heart and soon married Nettie Blewett, settling down on his farm in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c8 P23](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0023), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000)_
